name: generate_speech
description: Generate speech with Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (DashScope), save it as a current-session audio asset, and return the file name for serve-chat playback. This is separate from OpenCode Go, whose chat endpoint does not provide TTS.

voice.description: Optional Qwen3-TTS voice name; defaults to ai.speech.voice or Cherry.

language_type.description: Optional language hint such as Chinese or English.

model.description: Optional TTS model; defaults to ai.speech.model or qwen3-tts-flash.

instructions.description: Required style instruction when model is qwen3-tts-instruct-flash.
